signals.text: Miedema to miss start of season with knee injury. Vivianne Miedema will miss the start of the Women's Super League season because of a knee injury.

Arteta joins elite 250 club - but where does he rank?. Arsenal's fans are singing about winning the league again under Mikel Arteta. Monday's 1-0 win at Aston Villa demonstrated the strengths they have developed under their long-serving manager.
